pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: list: introduce list_next_entry() and list_prev_entry() Add two trivial helpers list_next_entry() and list_prev_entry(), they can have a lot of users including list.h itself. In fact the 1st one is already defined in events/core.c and bnx2x_sp.c, so the patch simply moves the definition to list.h. dut: use toybox df on Android board to get mounted device of a mount point. toybox is a new POSIX compliant command line utilities on Android. toybox df [file_path] will show the mounted device of the path, which is basically equivalent to df command on ChromeOS. By using toybox df, we can avoid guessing the mounted device by parsing /proc/mounts. BUG=None TEST=make test Change-Id: I45d0b49aae430ced07a4397765e07c05a06bfb6d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/322563 Commit-Ready: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org> Tested-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wei-Han Chen <stimim@chromium.org>

Kunimitsu: Fix leak on pin for battery_present. Since battery pin 5 is the voltage across internal 10Kohm thermistor and is not either 0V or 3.3V, typically 330mV with external 100Kohm. Using GPIO configuration to detect this pin causes extra power consumption and this pin is reconfigured as ADC. BUG=cros-bug-49610 BRANCH=glados TEST=check if battery is detected. Use 'adc' console command and check if it shows 'BATTPRES' with volatage in mV. Change-Id: I907b94629b0581a6a27e6f0cecda12ddef09a4f0 Signed-off-by: Kyoung Kim <kyoung.il.kim@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/322771 Commit-Ready: Kyoung Il Kim <kyoung.il.kim@intel.com> Tested-by: Kyoung Il Kim <kyoung.il.kim@intel.com> Reviewed-by: Shawn N <shawnn@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: cfg80211: Specify frame and reason code for NL80211_CMD_DEL_STATION commit 988568669d171774b96e59fe35ef575df7f8cffd upstream The optional NL80211_ATTR_MGMT_SUBTYPE and NL80211_ATTR_REASON_CODE attributes can now be included in NL80211_CMD_DEL_STATION to indicate to the driver which frame (Deauthentication/Disassociation) and reason code in that frame should be used to indicate removal to the specific station. This is used by drivers that implement AP SME and generate those frames internally. FROMMLIST: chromiumos-overlay: import ath10k fimrware 10.2.4.70.17-2 Import ath10k firmware 10.2.4.70.17-2 until it is available on linux-firmware. Here are the change lists between 70.12 and 70.17-2 (from QCA) --------------------------------------------------------------------- CL#1418719: Add RAW mode managment frame PN changes Increment the PN if TID based for encrypted management frames. CL#1409141: Issue 41423: ACS noise floor on channel 1 is 10 to 20dB lower than on channels 2-11 Description: If ChannelSwitch happens from 5G to 2G and dual-band radio, then do force reset so that NF value will be proper in channel 1 CL# 1432140 Issue: Mesh point and AP should support different beacon interval Change description: Changes to accomdate min and max beacon interval, Trigger the SWBA event according to the configured beacon interval for Mesh and AP. CL#1433901 Issue Description: Reporting per peer rx_duration to host. Change Summary: Rx_duration which we are calculating in FW will be stored in a variable in wal_peer and reported to host periodically in WMI_UPDATE_STATS event. CL#1439217 Issue Description: Intermittent instability of ath10k sw/hw, rate stuck in noisy environment. Change Summary: Fixes issue causing state machine stuck in FETCHING and FETCHED state, due to HIF_memcpy failure and HIF_memcpy delay in completion. Introduced two new events for DMAFAILURE and CACHEDROP to handle these cases. TEST=manually on whirlwind BUG=b:26464759 Change-Id: Icc7015d20a0b769192ed529a87916f8a5162630d Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/322845 Commit-Ready: Julan Hsu <julanhsu@google.com> Tested-by: Julan Hsu <julanhsu@google.com> Reviewed-by: Srinivasa duvvuri <sduvvuri@chromium.org>

The intention is to reduce boilerplate SPD handling code among x86 platforms.
